[Verse 1: tenor then baritone trading lines, bass and snaps]
Buzzing in my pocket, ringing in my teeth
A hundred little fires and I can't find the street
The news is at the window, the bills are at the door
The ceiling's on the carpet and I can't find the floor

[Pre-Chorus: guitar arpeggios, rising piano]
It's the weight of the day after day after day
It's the wait for a word nobody will say

[Chorus: drums open, both voices in unison]
So be kind, be loud about it
Be kind, stand up and shout it
When the whole world's wound up tight

Doo-lay, doo-lay, ah-ha
Doo-lay, doo-lay, ooh

[Verse 2: baritone then tenor, quieter and closer]

I watched another stranger hold her 'til she knew her name

[Chorus: drums open, both voices in unison]
So be kind, be loud about it

It's the only thing that stays
